field.name: project_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_BRACKET_REQUEST_PROJECT_LABEL
field.query: SELECT id AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(name, ''), CONCAT('ID ', id)) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project ORDER BY name, id

field.name: stage_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_BRACKET_REQUEST_STAGE_LABEL
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, ' (', project_id, ')') AS text FROM #__joomleague_project_stage ORDER BY project_id, sequence_number, name
